lines.text: Many learners say: He don't like tea.
Use doesn't with he and she.

data.why: Use doesn't with he and she.

native.tip: مع he وshe نقول doesn't: “He doesn't like tea.” وليس “He don't like tea.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “He don't like tea.” 😅 مع he وshe نقول doesn't، فالجملة الصحيحة “He doesn't like tea.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “He don't like tea”?
en.tip: With he and she we say doesn't: “He doesn't like tea.” not “He don't like tea.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “He don't like tea.” 😅 With he and she we say doesn't, so the right sentence is “He doesn't like tea.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
